in_sanskrit.name: गोपाल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who protects and nourishes the cows and their calves, and also the one who protects and preserves wealth. The term 'go' in Gopaal means cows, and 'pala' means protector. The name is also associated with Lord Krishna, who is known to be the protector of cows and the provider of wealth to his devotees.
